kitDescription: Ada is an RL/Electric/Attacker Burst III. When the team enters Full Burst, she buffs every Burst-3 ally who cast their Burst this rotation (herself included) with a flat +60% of HER ATK, +50% True Damage, and 10% lifesteal, for 10s. While Full Burst is active she lobs a Flash Grenade at the nearest enemy every 2s for 420% of final ATK as True Damage; casting her own Burst shortens that grenade's activation interval by 1s for 10s (roughly doubling grenade output during her own Full Burst). Her Burst gives herself +40% ATK and +42% True Damage for 10s, plus a one-round Special Modification that slows her next charge shot (Charge Speed −300% → ~4s charge) while massively boosting it (Charge Damage +1500%), turning the next charged rocket into a nuke.

redAssertions: 'Special Modification: chargeDamage +1500 & chargeSpeed -300 present' — the S5 test looks for buffApply stat chargeDamagePct/chargeSpeedPct events, but the driver encodes the Special Modification as a weaponSwap (chargeMultPct 1750 / chargeTimeSec 4), so no such buffApply fires. This is a RECON_ERROR of the blind's primitive guess (buff vs weaponSwap), not a kit divergence — both encode charge×17.50 and charge-time×4 faithfully.

'Special Modification lasts ONE ROUND, not a 10s window' (longCharge total > base) — the blind independently asserts durationShots:1 (kit-literal one boosted round). The driver ships durationSec:10 with no maxShots (~2 specials/window). This is the SUBSTANTIVE divergence — the documented F3 fidelity ⚑, corroborated by the S5 blind.

gotchas.summary: Special Modification 'for 1 round(s)' shipped as durationSec:10 weaponSwap (no maxShots) → ~2 boosted charge shots/window vs kit-literal 1 round.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Function: … for 1 round(s). Effect 2: Charge Damage ▲1500%.' Formula SSOT: 'for 1 round(s)' is literally durationShots:1 (round-count, null expiry). Driver ships weaponSwap durationSec:10 with no maxShots (~2 specials/window ≈45% of total). BOTH blind models (S2b fable, S5+S6 opus) independently re-derive durationShots:1 and flag the over-fire; the S5 blind's counterfactual asserts a 10s window deals strictly MORE damage than one round — i.e. it caught the same residual.
gotchas.suggestedFix: MEASUREMENT-GATED. Structure is faithful; count needs footage. Recipe: count boosted charged-rocket popups per Ada-burst FB window — if exactly 1, add maxShots:1 (or migrate to durationShots:1 on the charge buffs) to cap kit-literal; board would move ~0.99→~0.95. Do NOT pick a count to hit the board.

verdictRationale: Cross-family convergence is strong: the driver (sighted), S2b (fable, blind), and S5/S6 (opus, blind) independently converge on every load-bearing line — S1 fullBurstEnter→stage-3 burstCasters casterAtkPct 60 + trueDamagePct 50 (10s, lifesteal unmodeled); S2 420% true grenade in-FB every 2s with the burstCast ▼1s rider modeled as a second interleaved stream (A4 pins it live, 85 vs 55); burst self atkPct 40 + trueDamagePct 42 and a weaponSwap Special Modification (charge ×17.50, charge time ×4). All nine kit lines classify FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP; no SILENT_DROP, ENGINE, or ENCODING gotcha survives. The only real divergence is the Special Modification duration — kit-literal 'for 1 round(s)' (durationShots:1) vs the driver's durationSec:10 no-maxShots (~2 specials/window) — which BOTH blind models surfaced, and which the driver documents as a MEASUREMENT-GATED ⚑ (F3) with a popup-count recipe: DOCUMENTED_GAP, not a fudge or silent drop. Discrimination is solid (A1–A8 each GREEN-under-shipped / RED-under-nearest-wrong). The one residual the owner should spot-check (same-model risk: all agents are opus/fable but the fable cross-family pass corroborates) is whether the graded carry actually fires 1 or ~2 boosted charge rockets per window — resolving it to kit-literal caps the board ~0.99→0.95 but is measurement-gated, so it does not block GO.
